_comment: Professional credential tokens split off a provider name so 'Jane Smith, MD' yields a name plus a credential rather than two providers. Operator-maintained data, not engine code: add tokens here rather than editing Python. Compared after lowercasing and removing dots and spaces, so store 'pa-c' (not 'P.A.-C.') and 'phd' (not 'Ph.D.'). A run_config may replace this list with credential_tokens or extend it with additional_credential_tokens.
